name: ab_origin_invariant_causal_refinement
title: Origin-invariant causal refinement
text: A time-origin translation must preserve the physical trajectory, refinement decisions, and audit result when elapsed times and all other inputs are unchanged.
trigger: Translating an otherwise identical time grid changes the partitions and trajectory in causal filtering
check: Extend code/tests/test_review_regressions.py::test_translated_time_origin with causal filtering enabled. Compare the original grid with positive and negative translations, including partition histories and final states.
